title: Local Well-Posedness for Compressible Capillary-Gravity Water Waves with Acute Contact Angles
summary: Our purpose is to investigate the local well-posedness of the compressible Euler equations in a two-dimensional bounded corner domain with acute contact angles. This configuration describes a free surface intersecting the fixed bottom at two points, where the fluid is subject to a gravitational field and the interface between the fluid and air is influenced by capillary forces. When the contact angles are less than $π/2$, we establish a local existence theory for the solution, with dissipation effects occurring at the contact points.
